taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-10 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 104.3 | 6.31 | 6.31
2 | 416.7 | 17.57 | 23.88
3 | 264.5 | 2.29 | 26.17
4 | 856.9 | 2.63 | 28.80
5 | 641.5 | 26.88 | 55.68
6 | 7698.1 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-10
Curve type: KHKH-type (complex multi-layer curve)
Aquifer depth: 28.80 m – 55.68 m (Layer 5, 641.5 Ω·m)
Recommendation: Target drilling and screen placement within the 28.80–55.68 m interval, which corresponds to the moderate-resistivity saturated zone (Layer 5) sandwiched between a resistive layer above and the very high-resistivity basement (7698.1 Ω·m) below; case off the upper 0–28.80 m sequence to prevent collapse and cross-contamination from the overlying variable-resistivity layers, and terminate drilling once the basement contact (~55.7 m) is reached unless fracture zones are indicated.
